name: openbb_equity_price
description:
Daily OHLCV price history for one stock through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, start_date, end_date, prices: [{date, open, high, low, close, volume}]}, every row in the range, or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (upper-cased); start_date (default one year ago); end_date (default today); provider (alpha_vantage, fmp, intrinio, polygon, tiingo, yfinance; default yfinance).
Other sources: yf_stock_history, av_stock_daily; indices: openbb_index_price_historical. Keys: yfinance needs none; alpha_vantage uses SAJHA's ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; intrinio, polygon, tiingo need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "start_date": "2026-01-01", "end_date": "2026-06-30"}

start_date.description: Start date; default one year ago (YYYY-MM-DD)
